text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a concise plan for launch-signal orchestration for the 'smart-routing-v2' feature. PM asks: what are the exact signals we gate on, and what are our automated contingencies?

alex: +1. Goal is to target 5% traffic to the new routing logic, validate latency/quality, then scale. Need SLO thresholds and a deterministic fallback path.

kevin: Proposed signals: p50/p95 latency delta > 30% vs baseline, error rate increase > 0.3%, and end-to-end quality delta measured by prompt-set regressions (we'll use eval-suite v2026-03).

priya: For infra: also watch GPU worker saturation > 80% and queue depth > 200 reqs. If any infra signal trips, route back to stable router variant and triage.

rachel: For customer-facing criteria: if top-10 customers see QoS degradation > 2x or any paid customer reports major regression, we immediately halt and open a shiproom.

maria: Nice. Can we automate decisions? e.g., if three signals cross during 5m window -> auto-shutdown and scale-back to stable? Want minimal manual ops at 5% slice.

kevin: Yes — we can use the rollout-controller rule: require >=2 production signals OR 1 infra-critical signal to trigger auto-rollback. Example rule in feature-flag config:
```yaml
feature: smart-routing-v2
slice: 5%
auto_rollback: 
  triggers:
    - type: anomaly_count
      scope: production
      min_signals: 2
      window: 300s
    - type: infra_critical
      scope: infra
      min_signals: 1
```

kevin: That controller will also call the fallback API: `POST /flags/smart-routing-v2/fallback` with body `{ "reason": "auto_rollback", "signals": [...] }`.

priya: We need a DB-backed audit trail for why controller cut traffic to trace later. Put the raw metrics snapshot and diffs in S3 and a pointer in the change log.

dylan: Ops note — ensure we have a rollforward path. After rollback, controller should mark the slice as quarantined and require manual `resume` by PM + Eng approval. Auto-resume only allowed after a successful canary run on a 0.5% warmed cohort.

sasha: QA: we'll run two quick smoke suites on the 5% cohort: latency smoke (50 queries), correctness smoke (20 golden prompts). We need a green run before increasing to 25%. If the eval-suite shows any generated token-level regression > 1.5% on golden set, block ramp.

alex: A/B metrics: treatment vs control must be tracked across these dimensions: latency, token-cost delta, top-k semantic similarity, and customer error reports. We'll use existing A/B infra to collect treatment_id = sr_v2.

rachel: Stakeholders: support on call for first 3 hours of launch day, SRE alert policy mapped to pager for infra-critical signals. Notify top-20 customers via status or opt-in pre-warn.

maria: How do we handle partial region failures? If EU region shows issues but US is fine, we should narrow rollback to EU only, not global. Can controller do per-region scoping?

kevin: Yes — controller accepts `scope: region|global|customer_set`. We'll default to `region` scoping and only escalate to global if >=2 regions fail simultaneously. Config example: `scope_priority: [region, az, global]`.

priya: Also add a circuit-breaker for model-variant fallback: when qps > X or latency spikes, route to quantized variant (sr_v2_q4) that is functionally equivalent but lower perf characteristics. This buys time for rollback.

dylan: Ops checklist before slice: feature flag enabled in staging, rollout-controller integration tested with a mock signal, smoke-runpass, pager rotations on call, and a short runbook created.

maria: Runbook draft items: - how to interpret signal deltas - manual rollback steps (`/flags rollback smart-routing-v2`) - rollforward verification - comms template to customers and status page.

alex: One more: add a short delay between scaling steps (5m cool-down) to avoid thrashing when controller oscillates. Also a backoff multiplier for successive rollbacks.

sasha: I'll own the smoke-scripts and the prompt-set for eval-suite (sharing in repo: `eng-ml/evals/sr_v2_smoke`).

rachel: I'll coordinate support coverage and write the comms templates.

kevin: I'll hook up the controller and implement audit-trace + fallback API. Priya will validate infra alarms.

priya: Will add alerts and a synthetic test hitting routing path every 30s for early detection.

maria: OK — can we get a short sign-off thread by EOD? If everyone posts a one-line ack, I'll consolidate into the rollout playbook and create the feature-flag ready PR.

alex: Ack.
kevin: Ack.

priya: Ack.

dylan: Ack.

sasha: Ack — smoke scripts in progress.

rachel: Ack — comms drafted.

kevin: Ack.

priya: Ack.

maria: Great — I'll assemble the playbook and link the PR here when ready. Thanks everyone!"
